import React from 'react'; const hrHighlights = [ { label: 'Active employees', value: '284', detail: 'Across all departments', tone: 'blue' }, { label: 'Open vacancies', value: '08', detail: 'Hiring in progress', tone: 'orange' }, { label: 'Asset assignments', value: '36', detail: 'Equipment in circulation', tone: 'teal' }, ]; const moduleCards = [ { title: 'Employee Profiles', description: 'Maintain identity, role, policy, and emergency contact details.', status: 'Live', accent: 'blue' }, { title: 'Asset Management', description: 'Track laptops, phones, and issued equipment by employee and status.', status: 'Ready', accent: 'teal' }, { title: 'Recruitment', description: 'Manage job requisitions, candidates, interviews, and offers.', status: 'Drafting', accent: 'orange' }, { title: 'Shift Scheduling', description: 'Assign daily rosters, rotate coverage, and monitor attendance.', status: 'Active', accent: 'blue' }, { title: 'Performance', description: 'Capture KPIs, review cycles, and development goals.', status: 'Queued', accent: 'teal' }, ]; export default function HrModulePanel({ employees = [], departments = [] }) { const employeeDirectory = employees.length ? employees.map((employee) => ({ name: employee.full_name || employee.name || 'Unnamed employee', role: employee.role || employee.job_position_title || 'Employee', department: employee.department || employee.department_details?.name || departments.find((item) => item.id === employee.department_id)?.name || 'General', location: employee.location || employee.city || employee.contact?.city || 'Nairobi', })) : [ { name: 'No employees yet', role: '—', department: '—', location: '—' }, ]; return (

{item.label} {item.label === 'Active employees' ? employees.length : item.value} {item.detail}
))}

{card.title}
